title: The sea crossing as a type of baptism's defense
english: Their passage through the sea resembles our own situation in this respect: what the crossing through the sea provided for them—freeing them completely from their enemies and granting them secure freedom for the future—baptism has become for us against our enemies.

title: Baptism into Moses as a type of Christian baptism
english: The phrase “they were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea” (1 Corinthians 10:2) means this: just as those people, having obtained these things, promised to live by the Mosaic laws, so we too, receiving the Spirit of adoption in baptism, make covenants and confessions to live from then on according to Christ’s commandments.
The workings, clearly, of the powers (1 Corinthians 12:28).

Now when he says “faith,” he does not mean the faith of believers, the common and universal faith, but the spiritual gift of faith. For there was a kind of spiritual gift called by the same name as faith, which was supplied to many among the pious of that time for the manifestation of spiritual participation.

title: Faith as mustard seed and reproachful reading of 2 Corinthians 10:7
english: About this the Lord also says in the Gospels: “If you have faith like a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and it will happen” (Matthew 17:20). For he was certainly not discussing the common faith with them as if they were unbelievers.
Fragment on the Second Epistle to the Corinthians
This must be read with reproachful hypocrisy: you take your examination not from works—that is, from the truth—but simply from what appears on the surface (2 Corinthians 10:7).
